overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The notice had no license-renewal topic, but the Board did not discuss license renewals at the December 19 meeting, so the notice-specificity claim failed.

allegations.summary: Alleged the December 19, 2022 meeting notice lacked sufficient specificity because it did not list the businesses up for license renewal.
allegations.key_passage: When a public body does not actually discuss a topic, it cannot violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to the sufficiency of the meeting notice.
